title: 第5章 空有‘宝山’
content_zh:
整理了下那紫衣女子留在自己脑海中的信息，左晓瑶不仅从中知道该如何进出那处与外界时间不同步的空间，而那处空间则正是之前突然没入她脑海中的那面小镜子－紫缘境空，属紫尊三宝之一，另两宝一是名为传界梭的篦子梳，二为破禁锥的那根发钗?

三宝看似与古时女子常用的梳妆之物没有太大差别，但其能实现的功能却相当逆天，当然，这是对修真者而言，对普通人来说，它们仍是普通之物。?

修真者，这是左晓瑶从自己脑海中的那诸信息中得知的名词，修真者所处的修真境分纳气、融液、筑基、凝丹、化婴、成真六阶，每阶分前期、中期、后期、圆满期四层。?

而那紫衣女子不仅留有一套交待她要勤加修习的无名功法，且还送左晓瑶一缕草木神力，待她修到筑基阶后，便可借此力控世间草木之物的生死荣枯，威力不下紫尊三宝！?

不知此事算不算天上掉馅饼，但左晓瑶现在正为这段足够玄幻的经历发晕，她虽觉得自己当时与那紫衣女子的在紫缘境空中停留的时间够长，但直到她成眩晕中醒来，现实中只到次日凌晨而已。?

如今已对紫缘境空相当了解的左晓瑶知道，按她这个新任主人目前尚属凡人的情况，紫缘境空与现实时间的比差为一比十，待她正式突破至融液阶后，可达一比二十，基本是每晋一阶，比率都会加十，直至达到它的上限，至于上限到底是多少，就如左晓瑶现在只知道纳气阶的四段口诀，还不知传界梭与破禁锥的用法一样，按紫衣女子的说法是，时机到后自会得知！?

起身在房中来回走过几圈后，心情激荡的左晓瑶不知该如何表达自己的震惊与狂喜，在崇尚科学的今天，自己竟在无意中的窥得另一层面的玄奥，这是件完全颠覆她在过去的二十年中所受教育的大事，只是哪怕紫衣女不特意交待，她也知道，无论是紫衣女子的出现，紫尊三宝、草木神力及功法的存在，绝不可对外人说，无论现实中有没有与她一样的修真者，她也绝不能对任何人透露，当然，奶奶若在的话，自是另说，可惜.....?

想到奶奶，左晓瑶顿时心生伤感，先前的激动也随之褪去大半，若奶奶在的话，她们两个都可修真，即便奶奶年岁已长，难有所成，至少也能借此益寿延年，不至于早早的离开自己吧！?

静默片刻后，收敛起思绪，想到自己与王籽佳约在明天，这之间还有一天一夜的时间，而在紫缘境空中，就是十天十夜，倒不如先去试试修炼这功法，正打算行动，寂静的房子中突然传来一阵不怎么和谐声音，下意识的看了下周围，左晓瑶才想到自己好像已有两夜一天没有吃东西，难怪腹中已饿到前胸贴后背。?

煮袋方便面打两合包蛋，迅速吃完收拾好厨具后，拿着一个时钟，左晓瑶集中注意力全心想着紫缘境空，连人带时钟随后便顺利进入到紫缘境空中。?

再次出现在那栋竹屋的院门外，她已对这里的一切十分熟悉，整个紫缘境空不算太大，除种植着花木的前院外，听说后院还有一片灵田，面积比前院要大上许多，只是那些灵田中种植的灵药与灵木的品阶过高，对左晓瑶来说，在将来很长的一段时间里，那些东西都只会让她仅有看着的份，没有用得上的资格，且还不能拿出去，这也是紫衣女子临行前的交待。?

哪怕左晓瑶目前还不知道个中厉害，但从像紫尊三宝这样的珍贵之物都被那紫衣女子因情而弃中可看出，她的身份绝不简单，若非自己的伤怀与她当初留在紫缘境空中的那丝神识起了共鸣，且通过后来的交流彼此还算投缘，自己能不能得到紫尊三宝还真是两说，即便因机缘令三宝认自己为主，但无缘修真，便永远不什么知道个中奥妙，听她的，自是没错！?

熟门熟路的进入院中，来到竹楼前，先打开一楼的房间看了下，正对着的大门的这间是主厅，左侧的两间果然是丹室与炼丹房，炼丹房中的阵设倒俱全，只是左晓瑶已知道，与那后院药田中的宝贝一样，这些东西，即便她突破至成真阶，也没办实力用得上，只能干瞪眼罢了，好在在精于炼丹之技的紫衣女子给她留下的炼丹心得中，她目前可看得到的部分是从纳气阶可用丹药的炼制方法开始。?

炼丹房旁边的丹室中还遗有一些装着丹药的玉瓶与空瓶，瓶上分别贴着标签，上面字与紫衣女子在她脑海中留下的信息属同一种，与中国古代的甲骨文有些相仿，放在之前，左晓瑶自是一个也不识识，但她现在却能看能懂，毫不费力，这对除中文外，一直学不好其它语言的她来说，可谓是天大的福音，想到这，她对那紫衣女子的感激就格外的深。?

右侧是间专用来修炼的静室，但她虽有能控制静室中可调控灵气浓郁程度禁制的法诀，但作为一只尚未入门的菜鸟，在修至融液阶前，左晓瑶是根本启用不了法诀。?

虽空有‘宝山’，却都无法动用，但因过去那二十余年的生活经历，她一直是个非常踏实，且能很快接受现实的人，且还很容易感恩知足，对她而言，有希望与方向，那便是最大的幸福！?

来到二楼，见梳妆台后方的墙上只余一张空白画卷，左晓瑶心中涌出些许感激与遗憾，盘腿坐到紫竹床上，将那仿佛刻在自己心上想忘也忘不了的纳气功法口诀默念过一遍后，总觉得哪里不对的左晓瑶这才发现确实不对。?

事上无易事，虽有功法口诀“……鼻通六腑，出者轻清之气，属阳，接其天，此乃天根…..为阴中生阳；震兑两卦则互为魂魄，为阳中生…..阴阳运化之力贯通手足….”?

可对初涉此道的左晓瑶来说，显然还是有些太过为难，尤其这还是只纯正的菜鸟，压根不懂什么经络、丹田、阴阳、穴位，所以也就不懂如何按口诀纳气入体、运行功法，而那传她功法的紫衣女子的神识已离开，没有有经验的师长指导，就她一小白，如何摸得着这其中的窍门。?

无奈之下，本打算先离开紫缘境空，在电脑上查一下看能不能找到相关内容，却在无意中看到那两列书架，架上除摆放有一些三寸长的玉牌外，还有一些类似书籍的东西，虽不知这些用来记载内容的东西不知是什么材质，却能明显看出不是纸质，起身随手拿过一本‘书’翻看的左晓瑶暗自思忖道。
content_en:
After sorting out the information left in her mind by the woman in purple, Zuo Xiaoyao not only knew how to enter and exit the space that was out of sync with the outside world, but that space was the small mirror that suddenly disappeared into her mind before - Ziyuan Realm Sky, one of the three treasures of the Purple Lord. The other two treasures were the grate comb called the World Shuttle, and the hairpin that broke the forbidden awl?

The Three Treasures do not seem to be much different from the toiletries commonly used by women in ancient times, but the functions they can achieve are quite extraordinary. Of course, this is for cultivators, but for ordinary people, they are still ordinary things.?

Cultivator, this is the term that Zuo Xiaoyao learned from the information in his mind. The realm of cultivation that a cultivator is in is divided into six levels: receiving Qi, melting liquid, building foundation, condensing pill, transforming into an infant, and becoming true. Each level is divided into four levels: early stage, middle stage, late stage, and completion stage.?

And the woman in purple not only left a set of unknown skills that she should practice diligently, but also gave Zuo Xiaoyao a ray of divine power of vegetation. After she reaches the foundation level, she can use it to control the life and death of vegetation in the world. The power is no less powerful than the Three Purple Treasures!?

I don’t know if this is pie in the sky, but Zuo Xiaoyao is currently dizzy from this fantasy experience. Although she felt that she and the woman in purple stayed in the sky in the Purple Fate Realm long enough, but until she woke up from dizziness, in reality it was only until the early morning of the next day.?

Zuo Xiaoyao, who now has a good understanding of Ziyuan Realm Sky, knows that according to the current situation of her new master, who is still a mortal, the ratio of Ziyuan Realm Sky and real time is one to ten. After she officially breaks through to the melt level, it can reach one to twenty, basically every time she advances to one level., the ratio will increase by ten until it reaches its upper limit. As for what the upper limit is, just like Zuo Xiaoyao now only knows the four stages of the Naqi level, and does not know how to use the boundary shuttle and the forbidden cone, according to the woman in purple, she will know when the time comes!?

After getting up and walking back and forth in the room a few times, Zuo Xiaoyao, who was in agitated mood, didn't know how to express her shock and ecstasy. In today's world of advocating science, she had inadvertently glimpsed another level of mystery. This was a major event that completely subverted the education she had received in the past twenty years, but even if the woman in purple didn't.She specifically confessed that she also knew that no matter the appearance of the purple-clothed woman, the existence of the Three Purple Treasures, the divine power of plants and techniques, she could never tell outsiders. No matter whether there were cultivators like her in reality, she could never reveal it to anyone. Of course, if grandma was here, she would tell other things. What a pity...?

Thinking of her grandma, Zuo Xiaoyao suddenly felt sad, and most of her previous excitement faded away. If her grandma were here, both of them could practice cultivation. Even if grandma is old and has difficulty achieving anything, at least they can use this to prolong her life and not leave her early!?

After a moment of silence, he collected his thoughts and thought that he and Wang Zijia had an appointment tomorrow. There was still a day and a night in between, and in the sky of the Purple Fate Realm, it was ten days and ten nights. It was better to try practicing this technique first. Just as he was about to take action, there was a sudden unharmonious sound in the quiet house. Looking around subconsciously, Zuo Xiaoyao realized that she seemed to have not eaten for two nights and one day. No wonder she was so hungry that her chest pressed against her back.?

After boiling a bag of instant noodles and beating two packs of eggs, she ate quickly and put away the kitchen utensils. Holding a clock, Zuo Xiaoyao concentrated on thinking about the sky of Ziyuan Realm, and then she successfully entered the sky of Ziyuan Realm with the clock.?

Appearing outside the door of the bamboo house again, she was already very familiar with everything here. The entire Ziyuan Realm was not too big. In addition to the front yard planted with flowers and trees, she heard that there was also a spiritual field in the backyard. The area was much larger than the front yard, but the spiritual fields were planted in it.The elixirs and spiritual trees planted were of too high a grade. For Zuo Xiaoyao, for a long time in the future, those things would only be for her to look at, without the qualifications to use them, and they could not be taken out. This was what the woman in purple said before leaving.?

Even if Zuo Xiaoyao doesn't know how powerful it is yet, it can be seen from the fact that precious things like the Three Treasures of the Purple Lord were abandoned by the woman in purple because of love. Her identity is by no means simple. If it weren't for her own sadness and the trace of consciousness she left in the sky of the Purple Fate Realm.They resonated with each other, and through subsequent exchanges, they seemed to agree with each other. Whether or not I could obtain the Three Purple Treasures was a matter of debate. Even if the Three Treasures recognized me as their master due to chance, I would never know the secret if I didn't have the opportunity to practice. Listen to her, and you are right!?

A familiar person entered the courtyard and came to the bamboo building. He opened the room on the first floor and took a look. The room facing the door was the main hall. The two rooms on the left were indeed the alchemy room and the alchemy room. The alchemy room was fully equipped, but Zuo Xiaoyao already knew that with the treasure in the medicine field in the backyardLikewise, even if she breaks through to the True Realization Stage, she won't be able to use these things, so she can only stare at them. Fortunately, in the alchemy experience left to her by the woman in purple who is proficient in alchemy skills, the part she can currently see starts with the refining method of the elixirs that can be used at the Naqi Stage.?

In the alchemy room next to the alchemy room, there are still some jade bottles and empty bottles containing elixirs. There are labels on the bottles. The words on them are of the same type as the message left in her mind by the woman in purple. They are somewhat similar to ancient Chinese oracle bone inscriptions. Place them before,Zuo Xiaoyao didn't know anyone, but now she could read and understand them effortlessly. This was a great blessing to her who had never been able to learn other languages except Chinese. Thinking of this, she felt extremely grateful to the woman in purple.?

On the right side is a quiet room specially used for cultivation. However, although she has a method that can control the intensity of spiritual energy in the quiet room, as a newbie, Zuo Xiaoyao cannot use the method at all before she reaches the melt level.?

Although there is a "treasure mountain" in the air, she cannot use it. However, due to her life experience in the past twenty years, she has always been a very down-to-earth person who can quickly accept reality. She is also very easy to be grateful and contented. For her, having hope and direction is the greatest happiness!?

When she came to the second floor, she saw that there was only a blank picture scroll on the wall behind the dressing table. Zuo Xiaoyao felt a little grateful and regretful in her heart. She sat cross-legged on the purple bamboo bed and recited the Naqi Gong mantra that seemed to be engraved in her heart and could not forget it. Zuo Xiaoyao, who had always felt that something was wrong, realized that it was indeed wrong.?

Nothing is easy, even though there is a formula for the technique: "...the nose is connected to the six internal organs, and the light and clear air that comes out belongs to Yang and is connected to the sky. This is the root of heaven... It is the yin that generates yang; the two hexagrams of Zhen Dui are each other's soul, which is yang..."?

But for Zuo Xiaoyao, who was new to this practice, it was obviously too difficult, especially as she was still a pure rookie. She didn't know anything about meridians, Dantian, yin and yang, or acupuncture points, so she didn't know how to absorb Qi into the body according to the instructions and run the exercises. And the woman in purple who taught her the exercises had lost her spiritual consciousness. Without the guidance of an experienced teacher, she was just a novice, how could she figure out the secrets of this.?

In desperation, I planned to leave Ziyuan Jingkong first and check on the computer to see if I could find relevant content, but I accidentally saw the two rows of bookshelves. In addition to some three-inch long jade tablets, there were also some books-like things on the shelves. Although I didn't know what the material of these things used to record the content was, it was obvious that they were not paper. Zuo Xiaoyao stood up and picked up a 'book' and flipped through it, thinking to herself.
